title: Help fund early cancer detection research, built in public
md:
This research is independent, with no institutional or company funding. We fund it ourselves, together with people who choose to help. Every dollar spent on rented computing is listed, run by run, in the public [run ledger](Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/RUNS.md).

To help: **[Help fund early cancer detection research, built in public]({url})** (GoFundMe). To follow the work: [FOLLOW.md](FOLLOW.md). The live front page of all of this, with the experiments now running, the results and the costs: <https://hmahaffeyges.github.io/IAM-Validation/>.
